paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: The loss comparison between vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM. SepLLM achieves lower loss different computation costs and different training time consistently.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss values for a Vanilla Transformer model and a SepLLM model over training time. The x-axis, labeled “Training Time (s)”, represents a linear scale from 0 to 250000, with tick intervals of 50000. The y-axis, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, is linear, with tick intervals of 0.025. The purple line represents the Vanilla Transformer, beginning at approximately 2.65 at training time 0 and decreasing to approximately 2.45 at training time 250000. The red line shows the SepLLM model, starting at approximately 2.72 at training time 0 and decreasing to approximately 2.48 at training time 250000. Both lines demonstrate a consistent decline in loss values as training time increases.
